test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Supriya, Tanmay, Umesh, Viplav and Wasim are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Supriya is the immediate neighbour of Tanmay and Wasim. Umesh is to the immediate right of Tanmay. Viplav is the immediate neighbour of Umesh and Wasim.

Who is sitting to the immediate left of Supriya?
solution:
According to the given information:

1) Supriya is the immediate neighbour of Tanmay and Wasim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/832cd34aea34e3b9b931f252ef72e2b9cf1ad50b875e6f097312613e2a384cc3.png] 

2) Umesh is to the immediate right of Tanmay.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76d12b1fd877acc2f2f5e8db57382088f17d1b2afc524004da48aa4f7ddbd5b4.png] 

3) Viplav is the immediate neighbour of Umesh and Wasim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af2775274511a8b0ea2da7c83fe264c020700f69a24c49e57c68a54a3cbf67dc.png] 

So, **Wasim **is sitting to the immediate left of Supriya.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Wasim".**
